note: model_class: online inputs are generated by get_inputs() inside the task file from the global RNG (the evaluator calls it after set_seed; the consumption order of the random part is dy -> x -> scale, while the saved statistics are derived deterministically from x in the training snapshot convention and consume no RNG). This file records the fixed shape family of get_inputs as the machine-readable version of the task-statement contract; tolerances and global-domain shape constraints live in task.yaml. A hidden/perf case is a dict of {name + semantic fields}: name is a metadata key, which the consumer strips before calling reference.py::make_inputs(**fields) with the remaining semantic fields to generate the inputs deterministically.

shape_family.out_layout: dx: a single (N, C, H, W) tensor; dgamma_dbeta: one-dimensional (2*C,) packing -- the first C elements are dgamma and the last C elements are dbeta (each flattened in row-major order, computed in float32 and then cast back to the input dtype)
